description: This file defines a utility function 'utilGetUploadsConfig' that checks and returns upload configuration settings for a chat flow, including speech-to-text, image upload, and RAG file upload permissions, based on data retrieved from a database and flow graph analysis.

methods.name: utilGetUploadsConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and computes upload configuration settings for a given chat flow ID, including enabling speech-to-text, image uploads, and RAG file uploads based on flow data and node configurations.
